recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to light gray (hex #f0f0f0).
2. Add the title text "Neural Network Model" in bold red (hex #cc0000), positioned top-center.
3. Add the subtitle text "(Each node consists of Summation + Activation)" in bold red (hex #cc0000), positioned directly below the title.
4. Place a yellow circle (hex #ffff00) in the top-right corner containing the black number "2".
5. Add a pink (hex #ff99cc) rounded rectangle at the top-left labeled "Input Sample", with a dotted black arrow pointing right into the network diagram.
6. Add a pink (hex #ff99cc) rounded rectangle at the top-right labeled "Target Label", with a dotted black arrow pointing left from the network diagram.
7. Draw a feedforward neural network in the center consisting of 3 columns with 3 circular summation nodes each: left column blue (hex #0000ff) with Σ, middle column green (hex #00b050) with Σ, right column orange (hex #ff9900) with Σ.
8. Place the labels "Net_i", "Net_j", and "Net_k" above the left, middle, and right node columns, respectively.
9. Place the labels "O_i", "O_j", and "O_k" on the output connections of the left, middle, and right node columns, respectively.
10. Draw blue (hex #0000ff) arrows connecting the left column to the middle column labeled "w_ji", and connecting the middle column to the right column labeled "w_kj".
11. Add purple (hex #7030a0) circles containing the number "1" at the bottom of the current layer (middle) nodes to represent bias, and place the text label "Node Bias" adjacent to these circles.
12. Add 3 rectangles on the far right labeled "Output 1", "Output 2", and "Output m".
13. Add a vertical red (hex #cc0000) rectangle on the right edge containing the white text "Error Error" and rows labeled "Class 1", "Class 2", and "Class m".
14. Add 3 light gray (hex #d9d9d9) boxes at the bottom labeled "Previous Layer (i)", "Current Layer (You are here)", and "Next Layer (K)", with upward arrows labeled "i", "j", and "k" pointing to the respective layers.
